lines.speaker: Blond Man
lines.text: Ah, is this thing that you call tinola a variety of lotus which makes people—er—forgetful?

lines.speaker: Padre Damaso
lines.text: Nothing of the kind! You’re getting absurd. Tinola is a stew of chicken and squash. How long has it been since you got here

lines.speaker: Padre Damaso
lines.text: Have you come as a government employee?

lines.speaker: Blond Man
lines.text: No, sir, I’ve come at my own expense to study the country.

lines.speaker: Padre Damaso
lines.text: Man, what a rare bird! To come at one’s own expense and for such foolishness!

lines.speaker: Padre Damaso
lines.text: What a wonder! When there are so many books! And with two fingerbreadths of forehead!

lines.speaker: Padre Damaso
lines.text: Many have written books as big as that! With two fingerbreadths of forehead!
